title: ETF record (Empero Trace Format v1)
description: One line of an ETF .jsonl file. Exactly one of messages / text / completion / image defines the record kind; every other field is optional. Unknown fields are ignored by Brewery (use 'meta' for your own data).

meta.description: Free-form metadata. Brewery reads source, license, lang, synthetic, tags.

image.description: Path (relative to the .jsonl), URL or data URI.

content.description: A string, or a list of parts for multimodal content. Text-only trainers use the text parts.

id.description: Links the call to its tool result; generated if missing.

role.description: Aliases accepted on input: developer→system, human→user, gpt/model→assistant, function/observation/ipython→tool.

name.description: Speaker name (multi-party chats) or, for tool messages, the tool name.

reasoning.description: Assistant only: thinking trace. <think>…</think> at the start of content is also understood.

tool_calls.description: Assistant only. Several calls = parallel tool use.

tool_call_id.description: Tool only: which call this result answers.

train.description: Assistant only: false = context only, no loss on this turn.

weight.description: Assistant only: loss weight; 0 = no loss. (v1 trainers treat any weight > 0 as 1.)

returns.description: Optional JSON Schema of the result.

assistant_alternative.description: An assistant answer: a string, one assistant message, or a list of messages (e.g. a tool-using answer).

system.description: Shorthand for a leading system message.

tools.description: Tools available in this conversation (OpenAI 'function' wrappers are accepted).

tool_choice.description: Kept for reference (auto / required / a tool name); not used by v1 trainers.

documents.description: RAG context; passed to templates that support documents, otherwise added to the system prompt.

template_kwargs.description: Extra chat-template options, e.g. {"reasoning_effort": "low"} or {"enable_thinking": false}.

train_on.description: assistant (default): every assistant turn; last: only the final assistant turn; all: every token (CPT-style).

chosen.description: Preference data: the better continuation of messages.

label.description: Unpaired preference label (reserved for KTO-style training).

text.description: A raw document for continued pretraining.

completion.description: Continuation the model learns. No chat template is applied.

image.description: Path relative to the .jsonl file, absolute path or URL.

captions.description: Alternative captions; one is picked at random per step.
